key_fiscal_facts.value_text: 30% corporate income tax (Impuesto Sobre la Renta -- ISR). Applies to contractor contractual fee or profit oil share in CNH production sharing contracts. Pemex has separate tax regime (LISH). Royalty, contractual payments, and deductible CAPEX reduce ISR base. No petroleum-specific surcharge beyond standard ISR.
License contracts: sliding royalty 7.5-15% based on oil price; PSC: government share varies by field bid

Pemex preferential rights (derechos preferentes) allow Pemex to claim blocks before competitive bidding. CNH competitive rounds: IOC can hold 100% if Pemex does not exercise preference. 2025 reform strengthened Pemex first-mover advantage; in practice Pemex participates in majority of producing blocks. No statutory minimum IOC partner floor in CNH contracts.
